messages:
sam: Heads-up — HelixBank wants to kick off a POC next Tue. Key reqs: SSO across 3 subdomains (app1.helixbank.com, app2., admin.), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk on initial sync), and session propagation so internal services accept the user's session after SAML login. Can engineering confirm what we support out-of-the-box and any known blockers? cc @ashwin @olivia

ashwin: Quick summary from runtime side — we accept OAuth2/JWT for API calls and offer SAML SP for web login when deployed in Private or Dedicated modes. We do not automatically "forward" SAML assertions between internal services. Typical pattern: SAML => SP => create short-lived JWT for downstream services (we can emit this via a token exchange endpoint).

ashwin: Example exchange flow we recommend:
```
1) User authenticates at IdP -> SAML Assertion -> our SP (ACS endpoint)
2) On ACS success, we mint a short-lived JWT with claims (sub, email, roles)
3) Downstream services accept JWT bearer in Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
This avoids relying on browser cookie domain hacks across many subdomains.

mike: SCIM notes: we support SCIM v2 with PATCH/full replace. For initial population we recommend batching users in ~500-user chunks. We enforce rate limits on SCIM endpoints to protect the control plane — typical 429s happen under heavy churn. Our recommended client behavior: exponential backoff + jitter on 429s and on 5xx. Example pseudocode:
```
retry = 0
while retry < 6:
  resp = POST /scim/v2/Users bulk_payload.json
  if resp.status == 201 or 200: break
  if resp.status == 429 or resp.status >= 500:
    sleep((2 ** retry) * 0.25 + rand()*0.1)
    retry += 1
  else: fail
```
We also support incremental "delta" sync via list endpoint with 'If-Modified-Since' to reduce load.

olivia: For the POC plan I propose:
- Week 0: Okta app + test tenant, map attributes + groups
- Week 1: SCIM initial import (we'll run in staging, monitor 429s)
- Week 2: Validate SAML->JWT exchange and downstream service auth
I'll own the runbook and provide the Okta config snippet. Need HelixBank to provide an IdP metadata XML and a list of test users/groups.

sam: Pricing question from the customer: "Does SCIM or session exchange have extra per-user fees?" Any clear answer I can give now?

mike: Short answer for the POC: SCIM provisioning calls are not billed as per-user usage on the hosted API pricing, but very large provisioning spikes can trigger support-assisted quotas on shared tiers. For Dedicated/Private we can bump quotas in contract. For token/embedding per-token billing — that's separate and only applies to inference calls.

sam: Great — can you add that to the quote so finance doesn't get surprised?

security-qa-bot: Security questionnaire updated: HelixBank-SecQ #442 created (SAML metadata, SCIM encryption in transit, audit log requirements). Link: https://redwood/example/secq/442

ashwin: One gotcha to call out: if HelixBank insists on "session propagation" via browser cookies across app subdomains, we'll need to coordinate cookie domain settings and SameSite policy with their web teams. For true service-to-service auth, prefer JWT exchange. Also note role-based claims: we can emit groups->roles mapping at mint time but RBAC enforcement is up to the customer's services or our route-level policies if they want us to enforce.

deploy-bot: canary: scim-bulk-backoff-fix deployed to staging (build 2024.11.7-canary). Monitor /scim/v2/Users for 5m. :rocket:

olivia: I'll schedule the kickoff w/ HelixBank for Mon EOD and attach the Okta + SCIM checklist. Anyone want to join the call? @mike @ashwin

sam: I'll be there. Thanks all :thumbsup:
